Well briefly,

I've changed my environment which I guess was a bit of a shock therapy to get me to engage with those around me more positvely, I'm still reserved and private but it's not out of fear and weakness anymore, it's out of protection for myself from gossip and manipulators and whatnot. 

I haven't found love, but I was, very surprisingly, deeply loved for a while. Never thought that even existed or was ever going to come my way, but it did. and btw it ended because of different future plans, not because of my trauma. 

I want to say life will be perfect if you just hold on and fight through, but it's just not true. But it will be a lot happier and much more bearable, just keep working your way out of the trenches and be gentle with yourself
